links.outcome: Physician ratings of accuracy, understandability, relevance of LLM responses to patient record queries
links.effect: 210 responses rated by physicians; median scores of 5/5 for accuracy, understandability, and relevance; challenges noted summarizing conditions and retrieving lab results, with occasional omissions.
links.quote: A total of 210 LLMonFHIR responses were evaluated by physicians, receiving high median scores for accuracy (5/5), understandability (5/5), and relevance (5/5).

unlisted_practices: Patient-facing LLM app querying FHIR EHR data with multilingual and text-to-speech support

screen.reason: Evaluates a physician-rated, LLM-based mobile app for patients to query EHR data on synthetic patient records, focusing on system performance/evaluation without comparing or testing a specific deployment guardrail practice.
